headline: A 1995 executive order by President Clinton barred certain business dealings between the United States and Iran.
what_it_does: This order bans certain transactions involving Iran. Based on the title, it limits trade, money, or other business dealings between people or companies in the United States and Iran. No summary was provided, so the exact list of banned activities and any exceptions are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: US companies that trade with or invest in Iran
who_it_affects.how: They are barred from certain business dealings involving Iran.

who_it_affects.group: Individuals in the United States with financial ties to Iran
who_it_affects.how: They may be restricted from certain transactions that involve Iran.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed May 6, 1995; the exact start date is not given in the provided material.
